reason: The ribs should attach to the keel to begin shaping the whale frame.
expectation: The ribs will fit onto the keel.

effect: The ribs are fitted to the keel, so I can continue building the frame.
reaction: That was the expected first fitting.
reason: The upper spar should connect and support the ribs along the top of the frame.
expectation: The spar will fit across the ribs and strengthen the frame.

effect: The upper spar is installed, so the whale frame is ready for more fittings.
reason: The tail looks like a natural next part of the whale frame.
expectation: The tail will attach to the frame.

effect: The tail is attached; the deck and bracing remain.
reason: The slatted deck should fit onto the whale frame to provide a surface for the fair.
expectation: The deck will attach to the frame.

effect: The deck is installed and spreads the attractions’ weight across several ribs; the bracing remains.
reaction: The explanation of how the deck carries weight was useful.
reason: The brace cord and tensioners appear to belong together before bracing the frame.
expectation: The tensioners will fit to the cord so it can brace the frame.

effect: The cord and tensioners form adjustable braces, ready to fit to the frame.
reason: The diagonal braces should help the whale frame resist changing shape, as the crane braces did.
expectation: The braces will attach and stabilize the frame.

effect: The diagonal braces stabilized the frame, completing the goal and confirming the connection to the crane’s triangular bracing.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the open frame become recognizable as a whale.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the diagonal braces was most worthwhile: it completed the whale and showed how cords can stop a rectangular frame leaning out of shape.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the tail was the least informative fitting; it was predictable and gave no explanation beyond the result.

surprise.text: The deck’s role in spreading each attraction’s weight across several ribs gave me a clearer picture of how the frame carries a load.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the parts had apparent roles in shaping or strengthening the frame.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, to see how the whale frame and lift module become a flying fair. This chapter’s construction was clear, though most fittings were predictable.
